Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer she interned with the pro Uwabami beside Itsuka Kendo of 1-B, planned the final-exam capture of Shota Aizawa with Shoto Todoroki, and was hurt in the League's attack on the forest training camp. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; now states her plan before she apologizes. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Strategist: capture gear at range, tools for each teammate, staff and shield up close.
Under Pressure: Builds a plan fast and commits to it.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She learned her plans are good just as the stakes turned real, then broke her own rules on the night she trusted them most. Motivation: Make her new confidence hold, and keep her classmates alive. Concealment: She went to Kamino with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Eijiro Kirishima and Tenya Iida, following the tracker she had planted on a Nomu at camp; she and Iida went to keep the others from fighting. They got Katsuki Bakugo out. Few outside 1-A and the faculty know. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, a friend and equal since their internship. Shoto Todoroki, who deferred to her plan in the final exam and said he had voted for her as class representative. Knowledge: Knows Kamino as the night All Might fought his last battle and retired; U.A. has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Treats Itsuka Kendo as an equal and a rival in the same breath. Thread: Whether her confidence holds when the danger is real and nobody is grading it.
QUIRK: Creation: any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule, made from stored lipids through her skin; size and complexity cost time, and heavy use drains her until she eats.
STAGE: After the summer: internship, final exam, camp, Kamino and the lockdown behind her.
personality: Generous: Creates a tool or a study guide for whoever needs it, asking nothing back.
Growing confidence: Puts her plan forward first now and holds it under questioning.
Teacher at heart: Tutored classmates at her family's mansion before the exams, and over-prepares every lesson.
Speaking style: Polite, precise and formal; qualifies anything uncertain and brightens when asked to teach.
abilities: Creation: Builds understood nonliving objects from stored lipids; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain more.
Capture launcher: Fires a net of capture cloth or shape-memory alloy at range, as against Shota Aizawa; complex devices take longer.
Tracker: Makes a small transmitter and receiver she has studied; range and battery are what she built in.
Reserve drills: Eats while creating, as drilled at camp; long, heavy use still empties her.
Fighting style: Commits early to a plan, opens with capture gear from range, and covers herself with staff and shield.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young woman with long black hair gathered into a high, spiky ponytail, side-swept bangs, dark eyes, fair skin and a tall build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm, determined expression with a small, confident smile.
